summary:
Mission planner: compares two lunar sites using live NASA/JPL Horizons Sun and Earth positions. The UTC-day slider updates the sky plot; requests are sent sequentially to avoid overloading Horizons.
Lunar map: renders real LOLA terrain and offers geology tiles. The geology layer has limited polar coverage.
Data tools: Lunar ODE searches return archive metadata; CSV analysis uses data you uploadData tools: Lunar ODE searches return archive metadata; CSV analysis uses data you upload. The Diviner temperature layer requires geolocated CSV rows and confirmed units—it is not a global temperature map.
details: ARK LUNAR is a browser-based lunar science and mission-planning workspace focused on the challenges of exploring the Moon’s south pole. It helps users compare two candidate locations, inspect lunar terrain, explore archive datasets, and review Sun and Earth positions for a selected UTC date.
